artworks.title: Dutch captions to 'La Calvacatura con le sue Cerimonie'
artworks.medium: engraving

artworks.title: Niagara Falls
artworks.medium: stereoscopic glass transparency
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a store frontage displaying advertising for stereoscopic views. The image shows a store named "Niagara Park Place" with signage and advertisements prominently displayed. The display includes signs offering "Stereoscopic Views" and highlighting various themes, such as "War Views." There are various objects around the entrance, including a figure dressed in furs, likely part of the "INDIAN STORE" mentioned in the signage. The image reflects a 19th-century style, typical of early photography, with sepia tones. The visible signs and props create a visually engaging vignette of retail advertising from that era. The frame surrounding the photograph is ornate, indicating it might have been a collectible or special photograph.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: oil paint on paper, laid down on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Max N. Berry
artworks.description: The image depicts an abstract portrait showing two faces. The figure on the left has a roughly applied texture of paint, capturing the prominent facial features with broad, expressive brushstrokes. This face has blurred edges that blend into the background. The overall appearance is dominated by earthy tones and deep shadows. To the right, there is a more faintly represented face with similarly rough and expressive strokes, featuring lighter brown and white streaks that indicate hair and a faint expression. Clothing is not distinctly depicted, and there is no jewelry or objects in hand visible. The background is a neutral textured canvas, and there is a signature by Mancini at the bottom right corner of the canvas.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Hercules
artworks.artist: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo after Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of celestial beings amidst swirling clouds in a dramatic scene. The lines are detailed, capturing movement and expression. Many figures are shown in dynamic poses, some on horseback. The composition is complex, with figures converging towards a central point, creating a sense of depth and action.

artworks.title: Personification of Architecture with the Genius of the Fine Arts
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in red-brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene featuring classical elements. The drawing shows a seated figure draped in robes resting beside classical architectural elements. A winged figure is pointing towards an inscribed panel on a pedestal. The scene includes Latin inscriptions and scattered architectural fragments like a Corinthian capital. The composition emphasizes classical drapery and form, reflecting themes of classical antiquity and scholarly endeavors.

artworks.title: Study of Two Women, One Seated and One Holding a Basket
artworks.medium: graphite and white gouache on blue-gray laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two sketches of the same woman in different poses on a light grey background. The first sketch shows the woman standing with a hoe tool in one hand and the other arm around a woven basket. Her hair is tied back under a headscarf, revealing her facial features in profile. The second sketch shows her seated with her hand touching her cheek thoughtfully. She wears a long skirt and a fitted top in both sketches.

artworks.title: Sah er ungehalten aus? (What, look’d he frowningly?)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image depicts three men standing in a group. The man in the middle faces forward with his head turned to his left, looking at the man on his left. The other two men face him from either side. The man on the left wears a coat, a wide-brimmed hat, and curled hair. The central man wears a feathered hat, a jacket, fitted pants, and a cloak draped over his shoulders. He holds a sword or stick in his left hand. The man on the right wears a cap and a draped cloak. Each man has distinct facial features and expressions. The background includes large trees with detailed leaves and what appears to be a fence or wall with rounded finial tops.

artworks.title: Du bist schläfrig (Thou art inclined to sleep)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied figures in a natural outdoor setting. On the left, a woman is seated under a tree with her head tilted slightly downward and hands resting in her lap. She has delicate facial features and styled hair, possibly in a bun with curls at the back. She wears a long dress. To her right, a man stands upright with one hand extended towards the woman. He has a beard, wears a turban, a long robe, and loose clothing. The background features foliage and an indistinct structure covered in plants. The lines and shading create depth, suggesting a lush garden setting.

artworks.title: M. Edward Rogers, Robert E. Randall, and Charles F. Lennig, First Troop Philadelphia City Cavalry
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing closely together in military uniforms. Each man holds a sword in their right hand, resting against their left shoulder. The man on the left has his left arm resting on the shoulder of the center figure. They all have mustaches and wear caps. The background is plain, with a curved arch at the top framing the photo.

artworks.title: Petersham School in Miss Laura's Day
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.description: The image depicts a large group of children and a few adult women arranged in several rows. Most of the children are standing closely together and facing forward. The adults appear to be standing behind the children. The children vary in height and age, suggesting a mix of both boys and girls, wearing period-appropriate attire. Some of the children are in dresses, while others are in suits or shirts. Many of the children's hair is neatly combed and styled in ways typical of the time period. The women have hair styled, pulled back, and possibly tied into buns or other simple styles. They are wearing formal clothing indicative of the era. The photo is framed in a vintage golden frame with a decorative border. The background is plain, emphasizing the group. The image has a historical feel, looking like an old, possibly sepia-toned photograph.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: daguerreotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright with his arms crossed over his chest. He has distinct facial features, a full beard, and a hairstyle with a central part and side-slicked hair. He wears a dark suit with a jacket, vest, white shirt, and tie. Next to him is a chair with a jacket and a top hat. The background is a flat tone, and an ornate carpet is on the floor. The scene is enclosed in an oval frame with a gold border.

artworks.title: Ruins near Beirut, Lebanon
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with large, irregular stone blocks scattered everywhere. Two people in dark clothing sit among the stones. One person is on the left, resting against a stone, while the other is in the center-right, gazing ahead. The horizon is not clearly visible due to overcast skies. The color scheme is monochromatic with earthy tones. The stones have a rough texture, with wild grass growing between them. In the distance, a line of stone blocks extends to the horizon, blending with the sky.

artworks.title: Bishop Saint in Supplication
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person seated, with the head tilted back and facing upwards. The facial features are lightly drawn, with an open mouth and a nose. The hair is subtly shown, appearing short. The person is wearing a draped garment with visible folds and textures, resembling a robe or cloak. One arm is extended outward with an open hand, while the other arm is less visible. The background is textured, without distinct elements. The sketch is done in pencil on medium-tone paper, creating contrast through shading. No jewelry or objects are included in the drawing.

artworks.title: The Vision of Simon Stock
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing features multiple figures on clouds. A woman and child sit in a semi-upright position. The woman's face is detailed, showing a serene expression, and she wears a draped fabric on her head. The child next to her is also draped and rests against her side. The drawing depicts flowing garments enveloping the figures. Several cherubs with wings are around them. Below the woman and child, a kneeling figure in flowing robes reaches upwards. The background includes more clouds, giving the composition a heavenly atmosphere.

artworks.title: Caricature of a Peasant with a Broad Hat
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown washes on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person positioned off-center in an indoor setting. The person is standing with their left arm raised and bent at the elbow and their right arm outstretched with an open palm. They have a youthful face, long hair tucked under a broad-brimmed hat, and are dressed in a textured jacket, voluminous trousers, boots, and a belt. There is no apparent jewelry or objects in their hands. The background features a simple, geometric architectural structure with walls meeting at a corner and a tiled floor. The scene is bordered by a rectangular frame integrated into the paper.

artworks.title: The Mill at the Great Oaks
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a large tree on the right side, a body of water, a rustic structure on the left, and figures interacting with cattle. The artwork features intricate etching with fine lines detailing textures of leaves, tree bark, and water in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Christ in Gethsemane
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk, with brown wash and white gouache on light green-blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three winged figures in a dynamic composition. The drawing depicts three angelic figures with wings, rendered in shades of brown and white. One figure kneels in the foreground with a forward-leaning posture, while another stands behind with slightly open wings, and a third is positioned horizontally in flight. The figures are executed with strong outlines and flowing lines. The background is minimal and the use of white highlights gives a sense of luminosity to their forms.

artworks.title: Providence, Del. and Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral landscape with a small town nestled amidst hills. The town is located centrally in the image, with buildings and church steeples visible just below the horizon. The horizon is lined with rolling hills, creating a natural boundary between the town and the sky. In the foreground, there is grassy, uneven terrain with rocks and patches of vegetation leading towards the town in the distance. The black-and-white palette of the photograph accentuates the contrasts between elements and conveys a sense of calmness. The composition is balanced, with textures ranging from detailed grass and rocks in the foreground to softer forms of trees and buildings in the distance.

artworks.title: Man Reaching Down and Two Studies of Heads (recto)
artworks.medium: red and black chalks heightened with white on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment Fund and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image shows three studies of human figures on a textured brown paper background. At the top, there is a study of a male figure's torso, drawn in pencil. The figure is seen from the back, bent forward at the waist, with arms extending downwards, indicating muscle detail and curvature along the limbs. Below this figure, two head studies are rendered in red chalk. Both heads are depicted from a low viewpoint, looking upward. The head on the left shows a person with loose, flowing hair, lips slightly parted, and detailed facial contours. The head on the right presents an older individual with defined cheekbones, a more pronounced nose, and a textured hairstyle. The focus is on the expressions and the upward gaze of both figures. The background is plain with no additional objects or scenery visible.

artworks.title: The Terrace of the Ravier House in Morestel
artworks.medium: watercolor over traces of black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and  James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The painting depicts a view through tall trees towards the sky. The horizon is low, obscured by a structure and dense foliage. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive with an impressionistic style. Swirls and dabs of paint suggest tree shapes and a roofline. The color palette is warm and earthy with deep browns, greens, reds, and blues. Light yellow and orange patches break the darker tones, signifying sunlight or reflections on the ground and tree trunks.

artworks.title: A Village Street in Northern Italy
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache over traces of graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow alleyway with weathered wooden structures on each side. The stone path leads to a passage between the structures. The scene features bright foliage in green and yellow hues, creating dappled sunlight. Brushstrokes depict the texture of wood and stone. The composition is vertically oriented with no distinct horizon. The color palette includes warm earth tones, vibrant greens, and bright blue. A figure in a red skirt and dark shawl carries a bundle in the distance, adding scale to the scene.

artworks.title: A Satyr Entertaining His Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with an elderly, bearded figure playing a flute while surrounded by smaller creatures with human and animal characteristics, possibly mythological beings or satyrs. A dog sits near the figure's feet. The setting shows lush vegetation, suggesting a woodland or forest backdrop. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette of earth tones and fluid line work.

artworks.title: Advertisement for Edmond Ganneron, Ingénieur Constructeur
artworks.medium: photolithograph (proof without letters) on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an indoor space filled with various industrial machinery. The photograph captures a large room with a number of machinery, gears, and equipment. The machinery is arranged across both the floor and an elevated platform supported by wooden columns. The lighting in the photograph suggests it is taken during the daytime, as there is light filtering through unseen windows or openings, illuminating the machinery with shadows. The composition provides a detailed view of the shapes and designs of the devices. Each piece of machinery is distinct, demonstrating different sizes and configurations.

artworks.title: A Seated Peasant Girl in Contemplation
artworks.medium: watercolor with white heightening over traces of black chalk, on wove paper laid down on old mount
artworks.description: The image features a woman seated with one leg crossed over the other, her left elbow resting on her knee and her hand supporting her head. Her face is partially obscured by her hand, but her long brown hair is visible. She wears a long dress with multiple layers and a cream-colored outer layer with a patterned border. She also wears a white blouse with loose sleeves, white shoes, and the background is a textured surface in various shades of brown.
